RSI Pullback

In an uptrend, buy RSI under 40 and sell over 60.

The exact rule

  • Go long when close is above SMA(200) and RSI(14) is below 40.
  • Exit the long when RSI(14) is above 60.
  • Declared timeframe: 1d.
